correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication and Peirce identities establish a unique normal form for all derivations; applying D²-D yields the exact four projection constraints and a nonzero pure tensor obstruction unless characteristic is two. Rank uses an idempotent-preserved filtration, and Gaussian counts follow from image/kernel complementary subspaces and free image vectors. Exhaustive small-field original identities and all 65,536 binary four-dimensional maps corroborate the proof; no extrapolation from finite tests is used.

Upper triangular matrix-ring derivations satisfy the same operator identity but the algebras are not isomorphic and its diagonal-label formula cannot dominate this one.

value.rationale: The rectangular band is a canonical rank-one Munn algebra family in every dimension, with naturally complementary left and right one-sided ideals. The classification determines all projection derivations and their full rank frequencies; their tensor interaction causes a sharp, all-dimensions characteristic-two jump from m+n-1 to mn geometric irreducible components. This is a structural moduli phenomenon, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a corollary of an element-idempotent table.
